parse_iperf_stdout: parse iperf stdout lines to extract sender and receiver bitrate metrics in Mbps
extract_sender_bitrate: extract the total sender bitrate in Mbps from iperf SUM output lines
extract_receiver_bitrate: extract the total receiver bitrate in Mbps and runtime from iperf receiver SUM lines
use_iperf_parser_class: use the IperfParser class to parse iperf command output into a metrics dictionary
match_bitrate_regex: match floating point or integer values before Mbits/sec using the REGEX_VAL_BEFORE_MBITS pattern
